question: For evaporating sodium chlorate droplets at RH of about 59% and 34 C, what share formed single crystals without the magnetic field and with it?
trap: the 31 C row (11.8 / 26.7) or the coffee-ring column
rendered:
Document: Evaporative Crystallization of Sodium Chlorate Droplets under Controlled Humidity in the Presence of a Static Magnetic Field

The relevant information can be found in the table for RH ≈ 59%:

Without the magnetic field:
- 76.4% of the deposits contained single crystals.

With the magnetic field:
- 58.8% of the deposits contained single crystals.

So, without the magnetic field, 76.4% of the deposits formed single crystals, while with the magnetic field, 58.8% of the deposits formed single crystals.
